# Free for dev

A list of services and products that offer free tiers for developers.
This is a trimmed, offline sample for tests. It is hand-written in the shape of the
free-for-dev README and is not a verbatim copy of it. All links and keys are fake.
The wanted section headings (Web Hosting, IaaS) are the real ones, checked against the
README on 2026-10-24; the README also has PaaS and Major Cloud Providers.

## Web Hosting

Free hosting for static sites and small apps.

  * [Example Pages](https://pages.example.test) - static sites hosting with a free tier
  * [Sample Compute](https://compute.example.test) - free tier of 2 small VMs, always free for hobby use
  * [Demo Containers](https://containers.example.test) - free container hosting, $0 per month for small projects

## IaaS

Free servers and virtual machines, including Always Free offers.

  * [Example Cloud](https://cloud.example.test) - Always Free ARM instances with 4 OCPUs and 24 GB RAM
  * [Sample VPS](https://vps.example.test) - free trial credit for 30 days
  * [Tiny Box](https://tinybox.example.test) - free tier of one shared-core instance

## Databases

  * [Example DB](https://db.example.test) - free tier PostgreSQL with 1 GB storage
  * [Sample Cache](https://cache.example.test) - free Redis-compatible cache, 25 MB

## Email

  * [Example Mail](https://mail.example.test) - 100 emails per day free forever

## Monitoring

  * [Sample Metrics](https://metrics.example.test) - free plan with 10k series

## Unwanted: Games

Games and entertainment, kept only so the parser can skip a section.

  * [Example Arcade](https://arcade.example.test) - free to play browser games

## Contact

Send corrections to the maintainer. Contact details are omitted from this sample.
